optimizedDescription.value: Declarative YAML contract for schema kinds, artifacts, DAG, validation, metadata, workflow hooks, compatibility, and resolution.

optimizedContext.value:
# Schema Format

## Rules
- Top-level requires `kind: schema|schema-plugin`, `name`, integer `version`; full schema requires `artifacts`, may declare description, extends, compat, cross validations, workflow. Plugins forbid artifacts, workflow, extends, compat, metadataExtraction; may contribute documented merge operations. Unknown top-level fields ignored. Zod plus semantic validation precede domain construction.
- `compat`: string or `{name, version?}`; omitted version=1. `Schema.compat()` returns identity. `Schema.canonicalSpecSchema()` prefers compat, then parsed extends, then own name/version. Extends resolves recursively root to leaf, inherits compat unless overridden, detects path cycles.
- Artifact IDs match `/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/`; hook, validation, rule, cleanup, cross-validation, extraction IDs match `/^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(-[a-z0-9]+)*$/`, length 1–64. Hooks globally unique; other IDs unique within immediate array; workflow identity=`step`, participant identity=`as`.
- Artifact requires id, scope `spec|change`, output; supports description, template, instruction, requires, format, optional, hasTasks, delta, deltaInstruction, deltaValidations, validations, metadataExtraction, rules, preHashCleanup, taskCompletionCheck. `optional`, `hasTasks`, `delta` default false. Delta only spec scope. Output filename uses final literal glob segment, then template filename, else validation error.
- `scope: spec` syncs to repository/archive; `scope: change` stays working document. Non-optional artifacts required in change; non-optional spec artifacts required in persisted specs.
- `Schema.artifactDag()` is cached canonical requires graph: roots, children, parents, stable topological order, descendants. Production consumers must use it; no local graph rebuild or declaration-order proxy. Requires known IDs, acyclic; non-optional cannot depend on optional.
- `preHashCleanup` applies ordered regex substitutions before validated and approval hashes. `hasTasks:true` marks whole artifact mutable task state: excluded from approval and verification fingerprints, automatic content-drift invalidation, and parent-review propagation; still required, validated, counted, completion-gated, and archive-checked. Missing, unreadable, invalid required task artifact blocks.
- Base validations select via selector XOR RFC 9535 JSONPath, then optional zero-match `required`, cardinality and uniqueness `count`, `contentMatches`, nested `children`. Delta validations use same model against normalized delta YAML AST and require delta=true.
- Cross-artifact rules compare extracted same-scope key collections using `all-equal|subset|superset`; ordering `ignore|strict`. Duplicate prevention remains artifact-local.
- Metadata extraction maps fields to artifact selectors, extract, capture, strip, groupBy, transform, fields. `dependsOn` captures label and href; transform normalization failure is explicit.
- Workflow rows attach requires, task completion, and hooks to existing `ChangeState`; declaration order controls display and known-state axis, missing delivery states fallback-spliced. Rows never define or remove states or impose adjacency; unknown or duplicate steps rejected.
- Hook entry has id plus exactly one `instruction`, `run`, or `external:{type,config}`. Unknown external runner rejected after merged registry resolution.
- Templates resolve relative to schema, load eagerly, preserve plain text. Rules pre and post wrap instruction. Format inferred from output extension when omitted.
- References: `@scope/name` npm; `#workspace:name`; `#name` or bare default workspace; relative or absolute path direct. Missing file returns null; caller throws `SchemaNotFoundError`.
- `verify.md` mirrors `### Requirement:` headings and holds informative WHEN/THEN scenarios; verify normally requires spec.

## Constraints
- Every schema declares kind; plugin forbidden fields rejected.
- Duplicate or invalid IDs, unknown requires, cycles, invalid task references, invalid delta settings, duplicate or unknown workflow steps produce `SchemaValidationError`.
- Optional dependency propagates optionality.
- Delta format, selectors, application remain defined by core:delta-format.
